name: orbit-web
description: Orbit Web: a self-hosted, browser-based Claude Code experience with the Orbit plugin, shipped as one Docker image.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @orbit-web/governance-core && npm run build -w @orbit-web/contracts && npm run build -w @orbit-web/api && npm run build -w @orbit-web/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @orbit-web/governance-core && npm run build -w @orbit-web/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @orbit-web/api && npm run typecheck -w @orbit-web/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @orbit-web/governance-core && npm run build -w @orbit-web/contracts && npm run test -w @orbit-web/governance-core && npm run test -w @orbit-web/contracts && npm run test -w @orbit-web/api && npm run test -w @orbit-web/web
